tasks.short: Observe extraction equipment operation and detect actual problems.

steps.what: Observe and monitor actual extraction equipment operation for abnormal conditions
outputs: actual observed normal or abnormal equipment conditions

steps.what: Describe actual detected problems directly to the responsible extraction craft worker
inputs: actual observed normal or abnormal equipment conditions
outputs: actual craft-worker awareness of detected problems

tasks.design: Keep actual equipment observation and the separate direct problem handoff with the helper and responsible craft worker. A native monitoring display may provide readings, but it does not replace the helper's assigned observation of physical equipment and surroundings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual abnormal operation must be noticed in its physical context.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated software change to these particular helper actions.
tasks.still_hard: Noise, movement, leaks and nearby hazards require immediate situated observation.
tasks.human_edge: The helper notices an abnormal condition outside an instrument's measured variables.
tasks.altitude: No supported time saving in the defined observation and live handoff.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: physical extraction-equipment observation and live craft-worker problem communication remain situated human work.

assumptions: Provisional90 observation and10 direct oral problem handoff are scenario shares, not measured baselines. Record-write/report/send boundaries were inspected: this scenario assigns no written fault report, log entry or electronic send to the helper; the direct oral handoff is explicitly separate. Do not silently exclude an actual assigned fault entry: if discovery finds one, add it and assess native asset/fault forms separately before retaining this zero.

No instrument feed, automatic abnormality detector, transcript, report or notification is proposed. A native display can expose existing readings but cannot remove the actual physical observation duty without a defined validated change. Do not apply the digest's different occupation's billing workflow to this task.
unknowns: Does this helper actually own a separate written fault entry?
research_questions: Which actual observations are covered by instruments and which remain physical?

incremental.description: No software change is proposed, so no incremental maintenance work is assigned.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both bounds retain actual physical observation90 and separate direct oral problem handoff10. No supported change removes either action. Written fault entry is not assumed to be free or hidden: ownership must be checked, and any actual entry gets its own assessed step before this zero is used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organize extraction materials for actual use.

steps.what: Check actual required materials, labels, condition and physical work-area constraints
inputs: actual available materials and work area
outputs: checked physical materials and actual organization requirements

steps.what: Sort, position and organize actual extraction materials ready for use
inputs: checked physical materials and actual organization requirements
outputs: actual materials organized for the craft worker's use

tasks.design: Retain actual material checks and physical sorting and positioning. A stock-list view or pick-list template can show requirements but does not move, inspect or organize these actual materials.
tasks.previous_blocker: Materials must be physically checked and arranged for actual work.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported digital change to the defined physical handling.
tasks.still_hard: Condition, safe access and actual material readiness remain physical.
tasks.human_edge: The helper identifies a damaged or unsuitable item while arranging materials.
tasks.altitude: No supported saving in these physical organization steps.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: displaying material requirements does not perform physical sorting, condition checks or positioning.

assumptions: Provisional20 physical checking and80 sorting/positioning are scenario shares, not measured. Record/report/send boundaries checked: this scenario is physical preparation with no assigned inventory transaction or written handover. An actual stock issue, requisition or inventory entry must be added separately and tested against native inventory/pick-list functions; it is not hidden in handling or excluded to force zero.

No robot, new material feed, automated pick-list creation or send is proposed. Do not invent an administrative baseline or transfer the adjacent well-service billing workflow to the helper. A native stock view alone leaves this physical work unchanged.
unknowns: Does actual material preparation include a helper-owned stock issue or inventory entry?
research_questions: Is there actual repeated information entry distinct from moving and checking materials?

incremental.description: No software change is proposed, so no incremental maintenance work is assigned.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both bounds retain physical material checks20 and actual sorting/positioning80. No defined software change removes those actions. Any discovered stock transaction requires its own native-system assessment and a revised graph before using this zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Signal workers to start actual extraction or boring.

steps.what: Check actual readiness and obtain the responsible craft worker's start instruction
inputs: actual extraction or boring work area
actual responsible craft worker readiness instruction
outputs: actual readiness context and instruction for the start signal

steps.what: Give the actual agreed start signal and verify workers understand it
inputs: actual readiness context and instruction for the start signal

tasks.design: Keep the helper's actual readiness check and separate live start signal with the responsible workers. A software notification does not replace the agreed situated signal and acknowledgement in this scenario.
tasks.previous_blocker: The start signal depends on actual local readiness and understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software substitution for this particular signal action.
tasks.still_hard: Readiness, visibility and acknowledgement depend on real conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The helper withholds or repeats a signal when a worker has not understood it.
tasks.altitude: No supported time saving in actual readiness and live signalling.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a live extraction start signal and acknowledgement are situated physical-work communications.

assumptions: Provisional readiness65 and live signal35 are scenario shares, not measured. Record/report/send boundaries checked: no helper-owned written start permit, electronic control command or log is assigned in this scenario. If an actual permit entry or machine start commit is owned, add it separately with its actual authority and exact-final-version gate; do not fold it into signalling.

This is a person-to-person live signal, not a machine send, external message or author approval of a saved note. No new automated start, workflow message or existing-system runtime benefit is proposed.
unknowns: Is the helper's actual signal separate from any assigned start-permit entry?
research_questions: Which actual acknowledgement prevents an ambiguous start signal?

incremental.description: No software change is proposed, so no incremental maintenance work is assigned.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both bounds retain readiness65 and actual live signal/acknowledgement35. No supported software change removes either action; any discovered digital permit or control commit must be represented and evaluated separately before this zero is used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain actual extraction helper observation, handling and signalling.
skills_to_grow: Use clear agreed signals and actual readiness checks
role.ambitious_version: Improve clarity of actual helper handoffs without inventing paperwork or automating physical readiness.
